decisions.reason: It remains tightly linked to the firm's core market-data, calculation and analytics capabilities, so the firm can continue learning from customer use and improve it efficiently.

The product is still close to the established tariff and utility-process offer, and the firm's sector knowledge and in-house R&D make continued refinement more attractive than withdrawal despite its narrower gas focus.
This calculator fits the firm's central competence in regional tariff data and billing-related calculations, giving it strong absorptive capacity and a good basis for incremental enhancement.

Although it has lower standalone prominence, the product line builds directly on the firm's existing tariff platform and can be sustained through reuse of data, software components and customer feedback.

Its site-specific comparison logic is highly related to the firm's existing knowledge base and likely benefits from shared development and integration capabilities, even if its market visibility appears more limited.
